title: cardamine fallax
intro: Cardamine fallax, commonly known as lesser bittercress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine fallax include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to clear the lungs and airways of excess mucus. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine fallax include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
